metric.external_integration_coverage.limitations: Confirmation is documentation/README-based rather than execution-based; integration 'reliability' (e.g., libcurl timeout/redirect limits, FFmpeg lazy decoder reconstruction, OpenAI structured-output re-validation) is asserted in source docs but not independently load-tested by this worker. The one unconfirmed category (database/other network protocols) is treated as absent rather than assumed present, per the rubric's fail-closed design.
metric.external_integration_coverage.selection_rule: Evaluate working documented integrations and binding ecosystems, not only theoretical FFI design; FFI language design itself belongs to Language Quality.
